commands.review_summary:
The PR threads a fast-status credential-resolution-skipped flag through text status scan execution, shared status summary construction, and channel-summary rendering so skipped SecretRef checks say `credential not checked`.

PR surface: Source +21, Tests +31. Total +52 across 7 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-reproducible: current main skips credential resolution for fast text status and the channel table already has skipped-check wording, while the shared summary still renders the old unavailable-secret wording. I did not run a live configured gateway in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(status): report skipped channel credential checks accurately
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fast `openclaw status` now threads `credentialResolutionSkipped` into the shared
channel summary path so configured SecretRef-backed channels can say
`credential not checked` instead of the misleading
`secret unavailable in this command path`.

This follow-up fixes the last boundary bug in that change: when
`executeStatusScanFromOverview()` was called without a `summary` object, it
still passed `credentialResolutionSkipped: undefined` into
`resolveStatusSummaryFromOverview()`. The adjacent execute test does an exact
object match, so `check-test-types`/test compilation surfaced the mismatch even
though the runtime behavior was otherwise fine.

The fix keeps the new flag propagation, but omits the key entirely when the
value is `undefined`.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/commands/status.scan-execute.test.ts src/commands/status.summary.test.ts src/infra/channel-summary.test.ts`
  - `Test Files  3 passed (3)`
  - `Tests  23 passed (23)`

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior addressed:**
  Fast-status shared channel summary output now uses the skipped-probe wording
  `credential not checked` for configured Slack HTTP credentials when local
  credential resolution is intentionally skipped.

- **Real environment tested:**
  Local OpenClaw source checkout on macOS, rebased on latest `upstream/main`.

- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
  src/commands/status.scan-execute.test.ts \
  src/commands/status.summary.test.ts \
  src/infra/channel-summary.test.ts
```

- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
Test Files  3 passed (3)
Tests  23 passed (23)
```

Focused channel-summary regression:

```text
uses credential-not-checked wording when fast status skips credential resolution
  - primary (Primary) (bot:config, signing:config, credential not checked)
```

- **Observed result after fix:**
  The execute wrapper now conditionally omits `credentialResolutionSkipped` when
  it is undefined, the fast-status scan passes the skip flag into shared channel
  summaries, and the shared summary path renders `credential not checked`.

- **What was not tested:**
  No live `openclaw status` CLI run against a configured gateway; no committed
  proof scripts.
